verdict.rationale: LiteLLM ships several built-in event-triggered automations (automatic fallback to another model/provider on call failure or content-policy violation, budget resets on a schedule, rate limits per key/team) but these are fixed, pre-defined behaviors rather than a general user-definable rule/trigger-action engine (e.g. no webhook/if-this-then-that automation builder is evidenced). Missing for 10: a general-purpose custom rule/condition-action automation system, evidence of user-defined triggers beyond fallback/budget/rate-limit, and any webhook or external-action firing mechanism.
